title: GGT (gamma-glutamyl transferase)

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: GGT is an enzyme found throughout the body, but mainly in the liver. It is often read together with ALP to help tell whether a raised ALP comes from the liver or from bone.
context: Results can be affected by certain medicines or supplements, drinking alcohol and smoking. GGT levels go down after meals, so fasting may be asked for. A low or normal GGT is not usually a concern.
aboveRange: Some pancreas, heart or blood sugar conditions
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
